claims.claim: Advance voting over the first three days shows nearly 12 per cent of registered B.C. voters have cast a ballot ahead of Saturday's provincial election.
claims.episode_span: advance voting over the first three days shows nearly 12 per cent of registered voters have already cast a ballot
claims.source_title: Advance voting: Over one in 10 registered voters have already cast their ballots in B.C.
claims.supporting_quote: Advance voting numbers for the first three days show nearly 12 per cent of registered voters have cast a ballot in Saturday's provincial election

claims.claim: The province, the City of Richmond, the Port of Vancouver and a pair of First Nations warn of dire consequences from a decision granting the Cowichan Tribes Aboriginal title over land that includes dikes, private property and fishing grounds.
claims.episode_span: the province, the City of Richmond, the Port of Vancouver and a pair of First Nations are warning that dire consequences could flow from a land-title decision
claims.source_title: Landmark Cowichan Nation appeal sparks warnings of 'chaotic situation'
claims.supporting_quote: The province, the City of Richmond, the Port of Vancouver and a pair of First Nations are all warning that dire consequences could flow from a controversial land title decision granting the Cowichan Tribes Aboriginal title to land that includes dikes, private property and fishing grounds.

claims.claim: Private Aidan Goulding, 23, of North Vancouver, and Private Hayden Lykkemark, 19, of Langley, both of the 3rd Battalion, Princess Patricia's Canadian Light Infantry, were among four soldiers killed in a fire at CFB Wainwright.
claims.episode_span: Private Aidan Goulding, 23, was from North Vancouver, and Private Hayden Lykkemark, 19, was from Langley.
claims.source_title: B.C. soldier who died at CFB Wainwright ‘loved his army family’, mom says
claims.supporting_quote: The deadly fire at a Canadian military base in Alberta on Saturday claimed the lives of four Canadian Armed Forces members, including two from B.C.

claims.claim: Dona Wilkie was billed $13,586.88 for a transmission in a 2021 Toyota Highlander that the dealership said was 600 kilometres past a 100,000-kilometre powertrain warranty, and Toyota Canada later said it would cover the repair.
claims.source_title: B.C. Toyota owner battles automaker over $13K bill after transmission fails
claims.supporting_quote: Still, Wilkie was hit with a bill of $13,586.88 for a transmission replacement.

claims.claim: On Saturday, incumbent mayors and most of their slates were voted out in many B.C. municipalities.
claims.episode_span: on Saturday incumbent mayors and most of their slates were voted out in many B.C. municipalities
claims.source_title: Could change in B.C. municipal elections echo in provincial vote?
claims.supporting_quote: It was a night of change for many municipalities across B.C. on Saturday night as incumbent mayors and most of their slates were voted out of office.

claims.claim: A judge ruled that lack of access to earlier parole breaches the Charter rights of three people convicted in the killings of Arnold and Joanne De Jong, delaying sentencing until the new year.
claims.episode_span: family and friends of Arnold and Joanne De Jong will wait until the new year for sentencing
claims.source_title: B.C. judge rules Abbotsford killers' Charter rights were breached
claims.supporting_quote: The family and friends of Arnold and Joanne De Jong will have to wait until the new year for the three killers of their loved ones to be sentenced, after a judge ruled a lack of access to earlier parole breaches the killers' Charter rights.

claims.claim: TransLink says discussions are under way about a possible name change for the bus that replaces the 99 B-Line when the Broadway extension opens in late 2027, and the route would then run between UBC and Arbutus Station.
claims.episode_span: TransLink is discussing a new name for the bus that would replace the 99 B-Line when the Millennium Line's Broadway extension opens in late 2027
claims.source_title: 99 B-Line, the busiest bus route in Metro Vancouver, could be renamed in 2027
claims.supporting_quote: In response to an inquiry from Daily Hive Urbanized, a TransLink spokesperson confirmed that “discussions are under way about a potential name change for the bus route that will replace the 99 B-Line.”

claims.claim: In 2025 the 99 B-Line had nearly 10.7 million boardings, with weekday, Saturday and Sunday/holiday averages of 34,700, 20,700 and 15,100.
claims.episode_span: In 2025 the 99 had nearly 10.7 million boardings, averaging 34,700 on a weekday, 20,700 on a Saturday and 15,100 on a Sunday or holiday.
claims.source_title: 99 B-Line, the busiest bus route in Metro Vancouver, could be renamed in 2027
claims.supporting_quote: In 2025, the 99 B-Line saw nearly 10.7 million annual boardings, with averages of 34,700 per weekday, 20,700 per Saturday, and 15,100 per Sunday/holiday.

claims.claim: Scott Knight, 52, of Langley, died Sunday at Desert Park Raceway in Osoyoos after a multi-horse collision while driving Wits Beach.
claims.episode_span: Scott Knight, 52, of Langley, died Sunday at Desert Park Raceway in Osoyoos
claims.source_title: Harness racer dies in multi-horse crash at Osoyoos raceway
claims.supporting_quote: “Scott Knight, who was driving the number four horse, Wits Beach, did not survive the accident.”

claims.claim: Passengers on a B.C. Ferries vessel in Howe Sound reported feeling a strike on a humpback on Sunday, and officers are searching for the injured whale.
claims.episode_span: passengers on a B.C. Ferries vessel in Howe Sound say they felt being struck on Sunday
claims.source_title: DFO searching for injured whale struck by B.C. Ferries vessel in Howe Sound
claims.supporting_quote: Marine conservation officers are searching for an injured humpback whale that passengers aboard a B.C. Ferries vessel say they felt being struck on Sunday.

claims.claim: A Surrey man died in a Saturday morning wrong-way head-on crash on Highway 5 near Merritt, and the pickup driver is being investigated for impaired driving.
claims.episode_span: A Surrey man is dead after a Saturday morning wrong-way head-on crash on Highway 5 near Merritt
claims.source_title: Surrey man dead after wrong-way head-on crash on Coquihalla Highway
claims.supporting_quote: The driver of a pickup involved in the Saturday morning crash on Highway 5 near Merritt is being investigated for impaired driving

claims.claim: Environment Canada forecasts a sunny Tuesday for Vancouver with a high of 14 except 17 inland, no watches or warnings, and a Tuesday-night low of 7.
claims.episode_span: Tuesday is sunny after morning fog patches
claims.supporting_quote: Tuesday: Sunny. Fog patches dissipating this morning. Wind light except northwest 30 km/h near the Strait of Georgia. High 14 except 17 inland.
